desc:
🏔️ Welcome to Climb Mountains for Eggs!
🐈 The mountains have a thriving ecosystem, and eggs are spawning everywhere!

👍 LIKE THE GAME FOR UPDATES!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from mountain guardians
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare animals
💰 Earn lots of money from your animals
⬆️ Upgrade your oxygen tanks and hiking boots
🏃 Hike further up the Mountain
🥷 Steal eggs from other players
✨ Discover rarer eggs, pets, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
Follow @S1neaky & @ToyuRBLX for more!
